     nilai tukar, harga  ekuitas, dan harga komoditas.          equity price and commodity price. Market Risk is
    Risiko pasar melekat pada semua portofolio bank,          inherent to all Bank’s portfolio, be  it in the trading
    baik posisi trading book maupun posisi pada banking         book position as well as in the banking book within
   book   di  neraca  dan   rekening   administratif.          the  balance  sheet and  administrative  account.

    hingga   bulanan.  Untuk  meningkatkan   fungsi          increase such monitoring function the Bank utilize
